description: Create an Airflow DAG with branching logic for processing different data formats. The DAG should: (1) check the file format of incoming data (CSV, JSON, or Parquet), (2) branch to the appropriate processing task based on format, (3) each branch normalizes the data into a common schema, (4) after all branches converge, load the normalized data into BigQuery, (5) run validation. The branch_task should use BranchPythonOperator. Only one branch should execute per run.
edge_cases: BranchPythonOperator skips non-selected branches; downstream tasks must handle this
Empty file handling in each branch
Unknown format should raise AirflowFailException, not silently skip
common_failure_modes: FM6: Convergence task uses default trigger_rule='all_success' and always skips because branches are skipped
FM7: Missing validation for unknown file formats
